en: The postcard features a black-and-white photograph of a rural landscape with a prominent building identified as the 'GOODTEMPLARHUSET' (Good Templar House) in Fränsta, Sweden. In the background, there is a forested hill or small mountain with trees and some other homes visible. The reverse side has Swedish text, green printed 'BREFKORT.' and a green stamp, addressed to Herr P. Persson in Delsbo.
